module: Converts old vehicle data (v.data) to the current format at initialization: old drivetrain (engine/differentials) to a powertrain, hard-coded ESC (escConfig) to an 'esc' controller, and heuristic trailer detection to limit ignition levels. A modder does not need to call it: it serves old vehicles/mods whose jbeam has not been migrated. It modifies v.data in place.
notes: Order in init: checkOldESC, then checkOldDrivetrain, then checkTrailerIgnitionStates (must come after the drivetrain->powertrain conversion because it uses powertrain data).

Presumed trailer (no torque source nor vehicleController): v.data.electrics.allowedIgnitionLevels = {0} and ignitionLevelOverrideType = 'none', unless the jbeam already provides allowedIgnitionLevels.

Possible inconsistency: checkOldESC tests `v.filename == "esc"` while the controller is inserted with the key `fileName`; detection of an existing esc controller may therefore fail and duplicate the controller. Also, the loop shadows the global variable `v` with the loop variable.

init.desc: Applies all backward-compatibility conversions to v.data (ESC, drivetrain, trailer ignition states). Called by vehicle loading before systems are initialized.
